policy.entry_model: 1H/15m POI -> touch activation -> 5m liquidity sweep -> 5m MSS/CHoCH + displacement -> 5m strict FVG/validated OB retracement -> live RR >= 1.5
policy.note: Current open positions are always included while position_fetch_ok is true. Daily recommendations exclude symbols already included as current positions.
